inputs: One unmodified lexdiv_ngrams target and at least two uniquely named lexdiv_ngram_reference results
compatibility: Matching preprocessing_id, lookup_unit and resource_key_normalization_id declarations; all requested n supported; declarations do not prove equivalence
baseline: An explicit reference name or first reference by default
arithmetic: Reuse lexdiv_ngram_profile without changing its available-value statistics or source statuses
common_set: Target occurrences whose per-million rate is defined in every supplied reference; includes defined sample zeros; excludes unlisted incomplete-reference keys and zero-opportunity rates
weighting: Token occurrences or distinct exact component sequences within document and n
difference: Reference minus baseline on the common set; missing when no common values, including for baseline itself
common_coverage: Common occurrences or types divided by eligible target occurrences or types; missing for empty target
order: Reference-major; summary follows target document, requested n and token/type order; lookup follows target occurrence order
source_retention: Original target positions, source status and counts, denominators, complete flags, resource metadata and input content hashes; full reference count tables must be saved separately
max_rows: Positive bound on number of references times target occurrence rows plus twice target document/n rows; before profiling; not a total-memory bound
interpretation: Descriptive reference sensitivity only; no imputation, rankings, significance, proficiency or employability inference
